subject: snarling gray wolf head
_rhythm: slots copied from the @carve__reveal reference cut list (8 cuts / 11.4s)

stages.name: 01_first_score
stages.delta: The knife makes its first shallow score along the drawn outline of the ears and skull; one thin curl of green rind lifts and falls away. Everything else is still flat black drawing on intact green rind.

stages.name: 02_outline_cut
stages.delta: The score is deepened all around the head outline, pale white rind now showing as a thin bright edge following the drawn line, a few green curls dropping.

stages.name: 03_ears_skull
stages.delta: Green rind is shaved away from inside the ears and across the top of the skull, exposing broad pale areas that begin to read as the wolf's forehead and ear shapes.

stages.name: 04_brow_eyes
stages.delta: The brow ridge and eye sockets are cut deeper, the eyes taking shape as rounded relief with the dark green rind left as the pupils.

stages.name: 05_muzzle
stages.delta: The muzzle and snout are carved into raised three-dimensional relief, the dark green rind kept as the nose, fur tufts etched in fine lines across the cheeks.

stages.name: 06_mouth_flesh
stages.delta: The blade cuts through into the mouth, opening it to expose vivid red juicy flesh as the snarling mouth and tongue, with pale carved fangs standing out against the red.

stages.name: 07_fur_detail
stages.delta: Fast fine detail passes: dozens of short fur strokes etched around the ruff and cheeks, thin shavings flicking away and piling up below the melon.

stages.name: 08_hero_reveal
stages.delta: A cloth wipes the carving clean and the hands turn the melon slightly to settle it centered for the reveal.
